headline: Staff presented a legal review and recommendations on private roads, and residents spoke during public comment.
summary: City staff presented on private roads, including a legal review and the public services performed. About sixteen residents and a state representative then spoke during public comment, followed by council comments.
plain_text:
WESTBROOK FACILITIES & STREETS 
REGULAR FACILITIES & STREETS MEETING MINUTES 
MONDAY, AUGUST 3, 2026 AT 7:00 PM  
WESTBROOK HIGH SCHOOL (ROOM 114) 
125 STROUDWATER ST.  
 
 
  
 
 
I. ROLL CALL 
Meeting was called to order at 9:27pm by Facilities & Streets Committee Chair Anna A. Turcotte.  
 
City Councilors Present: Michael Shaughnessy (At-Large, Vice-President), Brian McCambridge (Ward 1), Anna 
A. Turcotte (Ward 3), Victor Chau (Ward 2), Amy Faulkingham (Ward 4), Jennifer Munro (Ward 5, President), 
Gary Rairdon (At-Large) 
 
City Councilors Absent: None 
 
Other City Officials Present: Eric Dudley (Director of Engineering & Public Services), Jennie Franceschi 
(Assistant City Administrator),  Angela Holmes (City Administrator), Ellis Ledoux (City Clerk), Joanne LePauloue 
(Director of Human Resources), David Morse (Mayor),  Robyn Saunders (Project Manager), Cameron Ferrante 
(Legal Counsel) 
 
  
II. STAFF PRESENTATION ON PRIVATE ROADS  
 
 Committee Chair Turcotte gave the floor to Angela Holmes (City Administrator) the floor to present a 
discussion on private roads. Mayor Morse provided an overview prior to the presentation. Angela 
Holmes (City Administrator) provided an overview of the agenda. Cameron Ferrante (Legal Counsel) 
provided an overview of the Legal Review on this discussion. Angela Holmes (City Administrator) 
provided an overview of Council's role. Eric Dudley (Director of Public Services & Engineering) provided 
a view of the public services performed and staff recommendations. 
Committee Chair Turcotte recommended the floor be opened for public comment before council 
comment due to the time.  The following spoke: Representative for Ron and Jacqueline Edgecomb 
(835 Cumberland St), Douglas Cartier 9504 Austin St), Linda Adams (60 Adams St), Shawn Adams (63 
Austin St), Ben Corval (397 Austin St, Jacqueline Edgecomb (835 Cumberland St), Charlotte Paulin (408 
Austin St), Al Arbogast (448 Austin St), Dave Rolfe (Edgecomb Rd), Larry McWilliams (383 Austin St), 
Martha Wilson (502 Austin St), Susan Austin (400 Austin St), Paul Gallant (465 Austin St), email read in 
to the record Susan Rice (31 Breton), resident at 34 Breton St., Suzanne Salisbury (House 
Representative District 128) 
Committee Chair Turcotte opened the floor for Council comment. The following spoke: Angela Holmes 
(City Administrator), Eric Dudley (Director of Public Services & Engineering), Cameron Ferrante (Legal 
Counsel), Councilor Chau, President Munro 
 
   
 
 
IV. ADJOURNMENT 
Motion to adjourn at 11:17pm 
Moved by Councilor Rairdon, seconded by Vice-President Shaughnessy 
Motion carried by show of hands. None opposed.
